summary: This video showcases a Thunderbolt element team competing in the Crown Contest against Fire Guardians. The featured lineup of Tariz, Perkunte, Maashtur, Alaura, and Sha'nachtan reaches over 6.19 billion total damage. Detailed end-of-run gear and stat priorities are shown for every hero, focusing on Enlightenment, Accuracy, and HP.

teams.note: Deals over 6.19 billion damage against Elemental Guardian - Fire.

tips: Build Perkunte and Alaura with full Enlightenment for maximum Thunderbolt damage performance in boss fights.
Ensure debuffers like Tariz and Sha'nachtan have sufficient Accuracy to land their skills against high-resistance bosses.
